decisions.selected: Measure whether each run produces its contribution-check report issue.
alternatives: Measure PR comments, labels, or agent verdict volume.
decisions.rationale: The workflow explicitly compiles a report issue and treats report creation as a completion gate; comments and labels are secondary outputs.

decisions.selected: One report-producing opportunity per workflow run.
alternatives: One opportunity per PR in the filtered batch.
decisions.rationale: The workflow's atomic repository outcome is one consolidated report issue, while the batch size is capped and may be empty.

decisions.selected: Use run ID as the stable opportunity key and reconstruct the case from run subject fields when case and event are null.
alternatives: Reconstruct the historical PR batch from current PR state.
decisions.rationale: Run ID identifies reruns as the same subject and avoids treating mutable current PR state as historical assignment evidence.

decisions.selected: Same-repository issue with the frozen title prefix and exact run URL in its body, created by cutoff.
alternatives: Safe-output traces or agent evaluation results.
decisions.rationale: The report issue is the accepted repository outcome; traces and activity do not demonstrate operational attainment.

decisions.selected: Twenty-four hours after run creation with cutoff capped at maturity.
alternatives: Immediate-only observation or an open-ended horizon.
decisions.rationale: The report is expected during the run, while a fixed day allows delayed safe-output completion and makes mature observations stable.

decisions.selected: Binary report-issue attainment: 1 found, 0 absent, null unavailable.
alternatives: Proportion of PRs evaluated or number of comments and labels.
decisions.rationale: A binary direct metric matches the singular intended report outcome without substituting output volume or agent judgment.
The workflow was introduced at adoption and no comparable pre-adoption report contract exists in the recovered history.

decisions.selected: Expose reportFound only as a separate diagnostic.
alternatives: Combine reportFound with comments, labels, or PR counts.
decisions.rationale: No diagnostic is needed for the primary score; the boolean context remains separate and never contributes to value.

uncertainties.description: GitHub issue listing can be unavailable or truncated by permissions or API failure.
uncertainties.mitigation: Return null rather than zero and retry during historical replay.

uncertainties.description: The report may be created after the run but before the fixed maturity horizon.
uncertainties.mitigation: Use a 24-hour maturation window and cap evidenceCutoff.

uncertainties.description: The observation does not establish that the workflow caused the report issue.
